claims.claim_text: This entire process took approximately ninety seconds.

The subject was holding his cell phone and appeared to be texting. I asked the subject to put his phone down, and he placed it on the center console. The subject then reached into a bag of food on his lap and began eating.
At approximately 1403 hours, the subject suddenly removed both hands from the dashboard and began reaching rapidly toward the floorboard area on his right side.
I immediately gave one verbal command for the subject to show his hands.
Within two to three seconds of the subject's initial reaching motion, the subject produced a black semi-automatic handgun and began raising it toward me.
Officer Yoon, who was positioned behind the patrol vehicle, discharged his firearm two times nearly simultaneously.
A standard semi-automatic pistol with a factory serial number was recovered from the subject's lap. One standard-capacity magazine was found in the weapon.
Paramedics arrived shortly after and treated the subject for gunshot wounds to his upper torso.
After approximately five minutes, K9 Officer Esquerra arrived with his K9 and entered the vehicle.
I observed a black Mercedes Benz with California license plate 8YQZ992 traveling on McClay Street and noted that the registration tags appeared expired.
When asked about supervision status, W-1 disclosed he was on AB109.
The subject was transported to Orange County Global Medical Center and was pronounced deceased at 1502 hours.
Both officers were wearing standard SAPD polo uniforms with black outer vests marked "POLICE" and had body-worn cameras activated.
I radioed dispatch at approximately 1404 hours to report the shooting.
